headline: Migrate whole applications to Rust using rust-anything
body: The tool incrementally converts codebases to Rust by testing against recorded original behavior. It supports HTTP servers, CLIs, and libraries written in languages like Python, C, and Java.
caption:
Migrate whole applications to Rust using rust-anything

The tool incrementally converts codebases to Rust by testing against recorded original behavior. It supports HTTP servers, CLIs, and libraries written in languages like Python, C, and Java.

Source: GitHub
https://github.com/erkamyaman/rust-anything

#ai #programming #softwareengineering #devtools #opensource #machinelearning #coding
title: rust-anything: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
